Opening your story studio…

A working prototype

Your experience, in your words.

This demo walks through an athlete interview, source-backed moments, review, photo tagging, and a visual story.

  • Choose live AI or mock mode. Live interviews adapt through OpenRouter and propose source-linked drafts with a second editorial check. Mock mode uses authored questions and verbatim answer grouping.
  • You approve the story. AI drafts are proposals. Review changes and source answers before applying or approving them.
  • A shared fictional demo, with no sign-in. Anyone visiting can view and edit live stories and photos stored in Supabase. Use fictional demo material. Mock stories stay in this browser.
  • Photos have optional context. Images are not sent to the model. Photo context is available to the interviewer, but must be confirmed in an interview answer before being used as story evidence.
  • Examples are fictional. Alex’s completed story stays separate from editable seed copies. Generated imagery and activity integrations are not part of this live demo.
